users.description: User accounts. For MVP, only one hardcoded user.

boards.description: Kanban boards. MVP: one board per user.

user_id.description: Foreign key to users.id. UNIQUE enforces one board per user.

position.description: Card order within column (0-indexed top to bottom)

example_flow.step_1: Create user: INSERT INTO users (id, username, created_at) VALUES ('user-1', 'user', '2026-03-29T...')
example_flow.step_2: Create board: INSERT INTO boards (id, user_id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('board-1', 'user-1', 'My Kanban', '2026-03-29T...', '2026-03-29T...')
example_flow.step_3: Create column: INSERT INTO columns (id, board_id, title, position, created_at) VALUES ('col-backlog', 'board-1', 'Backlog', 0, '2026-03-29T...')
example_flow.step_4: Create card: INSERT INTO cards (id, column_id, title, details, position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('card-1', 'col-backlog', 'Task 1', 'Details...', 0, '2026-03-29T...', '2026-03-29T...')

notes.normalization: Fully normalized for flexibility. Allows easy column and card reordering, multi-board expansion in future.
notes.json_fields: None used in MVP; all data atomic. Future: could store conversation history as JSON in a `messages` table if AI chat is added.
notes.timestamps: All times stored as ISO 8601 strings (timezone-agnostic). Backend should use UTC.
notes.id_format: Semantic IDs (e.g., 'card-1', 'col-backlog') for clarity. Could switch to UUIDs later.
future_extensions: Add message table for AI conversation history
Add activity_log table for audit trail
Add tags table for card categorization
Add multi-board support (remove UNIQUE constraint on boards.user_id)
